title: I LOVE WICKED!!!!!!! this cast is insane and you have one more week t...
transcript: I heard Derek Klena was back on Broadway and therefore I am back at wicked haven't seen the new cast yet I'm really excited to be here Lencia is out which is a little bit of a bummer but Lissa is in and I haven't seen Lissa before so very excited guess I'll just have to come back but I haven't been at wicked in over a year I haven't been to wicked since the movie came out and I'm also going to the movie on Wednesday because they're releasing the wicked for good trailer so just a good time to see wicked let's do it okay we did super close but all I did the sides so they're like technically partial view but um I'm not complaining there he is also happy pride okay I will see you at the intermission I kind of feel like I've been hit by a truck I cried um Derek Klena Perfect Danny Quadrino Perfect Allie Trimm might be my favorite Glinda I've ever seen Lissa is amazing Jenna is amazing Natasha is amazing I love this cat so much I love wicked should I leave now so I'm not spoiled for wicked for good? I'm a mess that was so special Derek he still got it 12 years later he can still be Fiyero have to go back to see Lencia soon and obviously I love Jordan Litz Fiyero so not a hardship fun fact wicked it's still good and I keep thinking about Jonathan Bailey’s ‘as long as you’re mine’ it’s gonna be insane
classificationReason: Creator attended Wicked and gives clear first-hand opinions on specific cast members (Derek Klena 'Perfect', Allie Trimm 'my favorite Glinda I've ever seen', etc.) and the overall experience ('I cried', 'so special').
